hypothesis: Do not call a scorer when the maximum possible bounded preference contribution cannot change the winner of the existing shortlist.
model_sampling: v3 snapshot sequence in manifest match order, indices floor((i+.5)*N/3), separately within development and holdout; same snapshots for both checkpoints, no confidence selection.
promotion_gate: Invocation candidate needs a tested fixed-readout proof, positive holdout skip coverage and zero paired shadow action disagreement. Model/strategy quality defaults need separate full paired-match evidence with no material regression; do not use capped HP leads as wins. No automatic UI/default update in this cycle.
stop_rules: Stop on first model error or busy gateway
Never stop a user's active match
Do not tune after inspecting holdout; next revision requires new holdout seeds
Every phase uses exclusive output files and pinned source hashes
